events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Big Day
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher turns 54 today! From Oasis frontman to solo star, his distinctive voice and swagger have defined generations of rock and roll. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Turns 55
angles.copy: On this day in 1971, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. More than just a song, it's a timeless anthem for peace and unity that still resonates today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, known professionally as Sting, the legendary musician and frontman of The Police, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: The legendary Sting turns 75 today! From The Police to his incredible solo career, his distinctive voice and songwriting have given us so many classics. What's your favourite Sting or Police track?

events.title: First Apple iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled its revolutionary portable music player, the iPod, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago today, Apple introduced the first iPod, changing how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. A true visionary whose music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The acclaimed English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy icon, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique humour has brought laughter to millions. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On November 22nd, 1968, The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed the Fab Four at their most experimental. What's your favourite track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his showmanship, his legend lives on. He would have been 80 today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul'! Released in 1965, this album marked a pivotal shift in their sound, blending folk and rock with incredible songwriting. What's your top pick from 'Rubber Soul'?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since the world fell silent for John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to echo globally. Remembering a legend who would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, the visionary artist and 'Starman', who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: The Starman would be 80 today! Celebrating the extraordinary life and music of David Bowie, a true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday King
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King of Rock & Roll! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, and his music still gets us moving. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and songwriter, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Led Zeppelin legend Jimmy Page turns 83 today! The mastermind behind some of rock's most iconic riffs. What's the ultimate Jimmy Page guitar moment for you?
